import { KrdsElement } from '../base.js';
export declare class Badge extends KrdsElement {
    static properties: {
        appearance: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        tone: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        size: {
            type: StringConstructor;
        };
        numeric: {
            type: BooleanConstructor;
        };
    };
    appearance: string;
    tone: string;
    size: string;
    numeric: boolean;
    constructor();
    render(): import("lit").TemplateResult<1>;
}
